content: Android emulator + Maestro flakiness in CI: Maestro issues document animation-timing problems (waitForAnimationToEnd not respecting timeout #2843) and global inter-action delay tuning (#1528); Maestro drives devices from outside via adb so it inherits emulator instability on GitHub Actions (emulator boot, KVM acceleration, adb disconnects). WebView content adds a second timing layer: web page load + JS execution inside the WebView can lag native chrome. Mitigations: explicit wait-for-idle/animation-settle steps before screenshots, generous timeouts, hardware acceleration on CI runners, emulator snapshot reuse, and treating screenshot timing as a first-class flake source.
